name: Bad Ems (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, yellow and red, charged at the top with the city arms of Bad Ems (a lion and a tower on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Ems; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Ems arms — lion and tower on blue
